      • Serialization Methods

        • readObjectNoData
          private void readObjectNoData() throws ObjectStreamException
          Refuses a serialized form that has no data for this class, which is one unruly-engine 2.x wrote: its base exception was io.github.brantunger.unruly.api.exception.UnrulyException. Java serialization calls this for a class the object's hierarchy has here and the stream doesn't, and would otherwise leave every field of that class and of the engine's subclasses of it at its default.
          Throws:
          ObjectStreamException - always, an InvalidObjectException
